# Why did my Shopify inventory import update nothing or set the wrong stock?

> Catch what makes a Shopify inventory import update nothing or set the wrong stock, with the line number, before you import. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
